questions.question: Excluding stoppages, the speed of a bus is 60 km/h and including stoppages, it is 48 km/h. For how many minutes does the bus stop per hour?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Excluding stoppages, the speed of a bus is 60 km/h.

Including stoppages, it is 48 km/h.

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

The average speed (including stoppages) = 48 km/h

The average speed (excluding stoppages) = 60 km/h

Time (T) taken by bus to travel 48 km with the stoppage,

⇒ T = 48/60 = 4/5 hours = 48 minutes

∴ At a speed of 60 km/h, the bus can travel 48 km in 48 minutes

For every hour, the bus stops for = 60 - 48 = 12 minutes

**∴ The bus stops 12 minutes per hour.**

questions.question: A dealer allows his customers a discount of 15% and still gains 10%. If the cost price of an article is ₹850, what is its marked price (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price = Rs. 850

Discount = 15%

Profit = 10%

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Cost price × (100 + profit)%

Selling price = Marked price × (100 - discount)%

**Calculation:**

Selling price of the article = 850 × 110/100 = 935

Marked price = 935 × (100/85) = 1100

**∴ The marked price of the article is **₹ **1100.**

questions.question: The seats allotted for ECE, Mechanical and civil Engineering in a college are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5. There is a proposal to increase the seats by 20%, 35% and 44% respectively. The ratio of the increased seats will be:

Seats increased = 20%, 35% and 44% respectively

**Calculation:**

Let seats be 30x, 40x, and 50x

∴ Increased seats of ECE = 30x × 120/100 = 36x

Increased seats of Mechanical = 40x × 135% = 54x

Increased seats of Civil engineers = 50x × 144/100 = 72x

New ratio = 36x : 54x : 72x = 2 : 3 : 4

**∴ The ratio of the increased seats will be 2 : 3 : 4**

questions.question: A purse was sold for ₹99 with a profit of 10%. If it was sold for ₹72, then what would be the percentage of profit or loss?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) = Rs. 99

Profit = 10%

**Concept used:**

Cost price × (100 + profit)% = Selling price

Loss % = (Loss/Cost price) × 100

**Calculation:**

10% profit means CP × 110/100 = SP

⇒ Cost price × 110/100 = 99

⇒ Cost price = 99 × 100/110 = 90

∴ Loss = 90 - 72 = 18

Loss % = Loss/CP × 100 = (18/90) × 100 = 20

**∴Hence, the **loss percentage
** is 20%.**

questions.question: The radius of a sphere is 6 cm. The sphere is melted and drawn into a wire of radius 0.4 cm .The length of the wire is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the sphere = 6 cm

Radius of the wire = 0.4 cm

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/511df9c6c38c8d4d5ea148b371774d903f3c5852e7b3441a3a0515c7edbff3db.png] 

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Volume of sphere= (4/3)πr³

Here, r = radius, h = length

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the wire be h cm

According to the question,

Volume of cylinder = Volume of sphere 

So, π × (0.4)² × h = (4/3) × π × 6³

⇒ 0.4 × 0.4 × h = (4/3) × 6 × 6 × 6

⇒ h = 288/0.16

⇒ h = 1800 cm or 18 m [As 1 m = 100 cm]

**∴ The length of the wire is 18 m.**

questions.question: The average of 4 numbers is 60 and the 1st number is 1 over 3 of the sum of the remaining three numbers. What is the first number ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of the 1st number to the sum of remaining 3 numbers = 1 : 3

Total ratio parts = 1 + 3 = 4 parts

Sum of all 4 numbers = Average × 4 = 60 × 4 = 240

Value of 1 part (1st number) = 240 ÷ 4 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 4 numbers = 60

1st number = 1/3 × (Sum of remaining 3 numbers)

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

 

 Total Sum of 4 numbers = 4 × 60 = 240
 
 
 
 
 1 part

 Sum of remaining 3
 
 4 parts = 240 → 1 part = 60

**Calculations:**

Let the four numbers be a, b, c, and d.

⇒ Sum of the numbers = a + b + c + d = 60 × 4 = 240

⇒ a = 1/3 × (b + c + d)

⇒ 3a = b + c + d

Substituting the value of (b + c + d) into the total sum equation:

⇒ a + 3a = 240

⇒ 4a = 240

⇒ a = 240 ÷ 4

⇒ a = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Basic Formula

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Number of observations).

Weighted Average

If group 1 has n₁ items with average A₁ and group 2 has n₂ items with average A₂, Combined Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Ratio & Proportion Method

When a value is distributed in a specific ratio, the required part is calculated as: (Individual Ratio ÷ Total Ratio) × Total Value.

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to ₹9,036 after 3 years and to ₹11484 after 7 years at the same rate per cent per annum at simple interest. What will the compound interest( in ₹) (to the nearest ₹) on the same sum for 2 years at the double rate of interest if interest is compounded annually?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 3 years = ₹9,036

Amount after 7 years = ₹11,484

rate of interest = constant

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

C.I = P[(1 + R/100)T - 1]

Here, P = Sum, R = Rate, and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Interest received for 4 years = 11484 - 9036 = 2448

So, interest for 3 years = 2448 × (3/4) = 1836

∴ Sum = 9036 - 1836 = 7200

Let the rate of interest be R, therefore

⇒ (7200 × R × 3)/100 = 1836 

⇒ R = 1836/(72 × 3) = 8.5

C.I = 7200[(1 + 17/100)² - 1]

⇒ 7200[(117/100)2 - 1]

⇒ 7200[(13689/10000) - 1]

⇒ 7200[(13689 - 10000)/10000)]

⇒ 7200[3689/10000]

⇒ 2656.08 ≈ 2656

**∴ The compound interest for 2 years is **₹**2656.**

questions.question: In an election, two candidates are contesting. The winner got 48% of total votes. His opponent got 34% of total votes and lost the election by 21000 votes. Rest of the votes were invalid. The total number of votes is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Votes received by winner = 48%

Votes received by opponent = 34%

Win margin = 21000 votes

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of votes be 100x

So, Votes of winner = 100x × 48/100 = 48x

Votes of opponent = 100x × 34/100 = 34x

Difference in Votes = 48x - 34x = 21000

⇒ 14x = 21000

⇒ x = 21000/14 = 1500

So, total votes = 1500 × 100 = 150000

**∴ The total number of valid votes is 150000.**

questions.question: Out of two numbers, the first number is three-fourth of the second number. If the average of the reciprocal of the two numbers is {7 over 48}, then the first number is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The first number = 3/4 × second number

The average of the reciprocal of two numbers = {7 over 48}

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Let the 2nd number be 4x

∴ The 1st number be 4x × (3/4) = 3x

Their reciprocal = 1/4x and 1/3x respectively

Sum of reciprocal = 1/4x + 1/3x = (3 + 4)/12x = 7/12x

Average of reciprocal = [(7/12x)/2] = 7/24x

According to the question, 7/24x = 7/48

⇒ x = 48/24 = 2

∴ The 1st number = 2 × 3 = 6

**∴ The first number is 6.**

questions.question: LCM of two prime numbers x and y (x > y) is 253. The difference between the numbers x and y is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

LCM of x and y = 253

Also, x > y

**Concept used:**

HCF of two prime numbers is always 1

**Calculation:**

We know that HCF of x and y = 1

x × y = 1 × 253 = 253

Now by prime factorizing the number we get

253 = 11 × 23

∴ The numbers are 11 and 23

Difference between numbers = 23 - 11 = 12

**∴ The difference between the numbers x and y is 12.**

questions.question: An athelete runs 8 times around a circular field of radius 14 m in 2 minutes 56 seconds. Find his speed.

Speed = Distance/Time

Circumference of circle = 2πR

Speed = Distance/time = 704/176 = 4 m/sec

**∴ The speed of the athlete is 4 m/sec.**

questions.question: If a given number 758P09Q5 is divisible by 3, then the least value of P + Q is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

758P09Q5 is divisible by 3

**Concept used:**

A number is completely divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 7 + 5 + 8 + P + 0 + 9 + Q + 5 = 34 + P + Q

∴ 34 + P + Q must be divisible by 3

The closest number which is divisible by 3 to 34 is 36

So, P + Q = 36 - 34 = 2

**∴ The least value of P + Q is 2.**

where s → semi-perimeter of the triangle and a, b, c are the sides of the triangle.
